name: Canonical Flop Board Texture GTO Continuation-Bet, Check-Raise & Turn Barrel Benchmarks (2026)
description: Quantitative 100BB postflop solver benchmark covering 12 canonical No-Limit Hold'em flop board textures (A-7-2r, K-7-2r, Q-J-T, J-T-8ss, 8-7-6ss, Ks-9s-4s monotone, K-K-4r, 7-4-4r, K-Q-5ss, A-5-4ss, 9-5-2r, 8-8-8 trips) with IP vs OOP range advantage, nut advantage, GTO C-bet frequency %, optimal C-bet sizing, check-raise frequency %, and best turn barrel runouts.
category: GTO Postflop & Flop Board Texture Strategy

rows.range_advantage: Heavy In-Position Preflop Raiser (+58% To 42% Equity)
rows.best_turn_barrels: King, Queen, Jack, And Offsuit Paint Overcards (Ks, Qd, Jh)
rows.summary: Ace-High Dry Rainbow Flops (Such As As 7d 2c Or Ah 8c 3d) Represent The Strongest Static Range-Advantage Texture For The Preflop Raiser. Because The Opener Holds All Pocket Aces, AK, AQ, And Strong Ax While The Big Blind Defender Lacks Two-Pair Combinations And Straight Draws, Solvers Recommend An 88% To 96% Small 33% Pot Range Continuation Bet.
rows.ip_strategy: Simplify To A Near-100% Range Continuation Bet Sized At 25% To 33% Pot In Single-Raised Pots (BTN Vs BB Or UTG Vs BB). | Include Underpairs (88-KK), Broadway Overcards (KQs, QJs), And Backdoor Wheel Gutshots (65s, 54s) In Your Small 33% Bet Range To Deny The Big Blind's 6-Out Overcard Equity. | Size Up To A Polarized 75% To 125% Turn Barrel When A Broadway Card (K, Q, J) Lands On The Turn, Or Check Back Medium Ax And Underpairs For Pot Control.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Avoid Over-Check-Raising: Because The Preflop Raiser Holds All Top Set AA And Top-Kicker Ax Combinations, Check-Raise Only ~6% To 8% Centered Around 77, 22, A7s, A2s, And Backdoor Wheel Bluffs (54s, 65s). | Float The Small 33% Flop C-Bet With Weak Ax, Pocket Pairs 33-99, And Suited Broadways Holding A Backdoor Flush Draw. | Lead Or Probe-Bet Low Pairing Turn Cards (7x Or 2x) If The Preflop Raiser Checks Back The Flop.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: Double-Barrel Aggressively (75% To 100% Pot) On Broadway Turn Cards (K, Q, J) That Improve Your Range's Secondary Equity, While Slowing Down On Low Turn Cards (3, 4, 5, 6) That Complete The Big Blind's Wheel Straight And Two-Pair Region.

rows.range_advantage: Strong In-Position Preflop Raiser (+56% To 44% Equity)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Ace, Queen, Jack, And Non-Pairing Broadway Cards
rows.summary: King-High Disconnected Rainbow Flops (Such As Ks 7h 2d Or Kh 8c 3s) Are Classic Static Dry Textures Where Only Three Straight Combinations Exist And Equity Shifts Slowly Across Turn And River Cards. The Preflop Aggressor C-Bets 85% To 94% Of Hands For 33% Pot To Fold Out Unpaired Overcards And Extract Thin Value.
rows.ip_strategy: Deploy A Unified 33% Pot Range C-Bet Across Nearly Your Entire Opening Range (AA, Kx, Pocket Pairs 33-QQ, Ace-High, And Backdoor Draws). | When Facing A Flop Check-Raise From The Big Blind On K-7-2r, Defend Wide By Calling With All Kx, Pocket Pairs 77+, Backdoor Nut Flush Draws, And Ace-High With Backdoor Equity. | Fire Polarized 75% Turn Barrels With AK, KQ, AA, Sets, And Turned Flush/Straight Draws While Checking Back Weak Kx And Medium Pairs (88-QQ).
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Check-Raise At 9% To 12% Frequency Because K-7-2r Contains Zero Obvious Front-Door Draws: Merge 77, 22, K7s, And Strong Kx With Backdoor Straight/Flush Bluffs (98s, 86s, 65s, A5s). | Call The 33% C-Bet With Any Pair (2x, 7x, 33-JJ, Kx) Plus Strong Ace-High Hands (AQo, AJs, ATs). | Attack Turn Check-Backs With A 75% River Probe Bet Whenever The Preflop Raiser Caps Their Range On The Turn.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: An Ace On The Turn Is Still A High-Leverage Barrel Card For The Preflop Raiser (Who Retains All AA, AK, AQ, AJ), Allowing Continued Polarized Pressure Against The Big Blind's 7x And Medium Pocket Pairs.

rows.range_advantage: Heavily Favors Preflop Raiser (+61% To 39% Equity)
rows.nut_advantage: Massive Preflop Raiser Nut Advantage (AK, KK, QQ, JJ, TT, K9s)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Ace, King, Or Brick Deuce/Trey That Preserves Nut Straight Edge
rows.summary: High Broadway-Connected Flops (Such As Qs Jh Td, Ks Qd Jc, Or Js Th 9c) Smash The Preflop Raiser's Range Harder Than Almost Any Other Texture. Because The Big Blind 3-Bets Most AK, QQ, And JJ Preflop, The Big Blind Is Capped At Lower Straights And Two Pairs While The Opener Holds All Nut Straights (AK) And Top Sets, Driving Large 75% Polarized C-Bets.
rows.ip_strategy: Shift Away From 33% Small Bets Toward Large 66% To 75% Pot Polarized C-Bets To Leverage Your Massive Nut Advantage (AK Nut Straight, QQ, JJ, TT, QJs). | Use Hands With A Single King Or Ace Blocker (Such As ATo, KTo, AJs, KJs) As High-Equity Semi-Bluffs That Can Barrel Or Realize Nut Straight Outs. | Check Back Vulnerable Underpairs (66-99) That Have Zero Straight Blockers And Minimal Improvement Equity.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Play Defensively Out Of Position: Even When You Flop Two Pair (QTo, JTo) Or A Low Straight (98s), Recognize That The Preflop Raiser Holds All AK, QQ, And JJ Combinations. | Fold One-Pair Hands Without A Straight Draw (Such As T7s Or J6s) Immediately Against A 75% Pot Continuation Bet. | Check-Call Most Of Your Two Pairs And Straights Rather Than Bloating The Pot Out Of Position Against An Uncapped Range.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: On A Brick Turn (2, 3, 4), The Preflop Raiser Can Fire A 100% To 125% Pot Turn Overbet With AK, Sets, And King-Blocker Combo Draws, Putting The Big Blind's Two-Pair Hands In A Vice.

rows.range_advantage: Neutral / Slight In-Position Edge (51% To 49% Equity)
rows.nut_advantage: Shared (Both Ranges Hold Q9s, 97s, 88, TT, JJ)
rows.summary: Middling Connected Two-Tone Flops (Such As Js Ts 8d, Th 9h 7c, Or Jh 9h 8d) Are Highly Dynamic Wet Boards Where Both The Preflop Raiser And The Big Blind Defender Hold Nut Straights (Q9, 97), Two Pairs, And Monster Combo Draws. Consequently, C-Bet Frequency Drops To ~42% Using A Polarized 75% Sizing.
rows.ip_strategy: Stop Range-Betting 33%: Check Back 50% To 60% Of Your Range (Including Weak Top Pairs, Medium Pocket Pairs 77-99, And Unimproved A-High Without Draws). | When You Do Bet, Size Up To 66% To 75% Pot With A Polarized Mix Of Strong Made Hands (Q9s, Sets, Top Two Pair, Overpairs QQ+) And High-Equity Draws (Flush Draws, Open-Enders, Overcard + Gutshot). | Protect Your Check-Back Range By Checking Some Overpairs (AA/KK With A Spade) And Top Pair Hands So The Big Blind Cannot Auto-Overbet Every Turn.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Attack Any Opener Who Mistakenly Uses A Small 33% C-Bet On J-T-8 Two-Tone By Check-Raising 16% To 20% Of Your Range. | Build Your Check-Raise Range Around Flopped Straights (Q9, 97), Sets (88), Two Pairs (JTs, J8s, T8s), And Combo Draws (Flush Draws With A Pair Or Gutshot). | When The Preflop Raiser Checks Back The Flop, Lead Out 75% Pot On The Turn With Made Hands And Draws To Seize The Initiative.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: Over Half The Deck Changes The Nuts On The Turn (Any Spade, Queen, Nine, Seven, Or Board-Pairing Card). Only Barrel Turn Cards That Improve Your Equity Or Brick Out The Defender's Obvious Draws.

rows.range_advantage: Big Blind / Caller Advantage Against Early Opens (47% To 53%)
rows.nut_advantage: Big Blind Defender (Holds More T9, 95, 54, Two Pairs & Low Sets)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Offsuit Ace, King, Or Brick Deuce
rows.summary: Low Connected Coordinated Flops (Such As 8s 7s 6d, 7h 6h 5c, Or 6s 5s 4d) Are The Single Worst Board Texture For An Early- Or Middle-Position Preflop Raiser. Because The Opener Folded Hands Like 95s, 86s, 75s, And 54o Preflop While The Big Blind Called Them All, The Defender Holds Both The Range And Nut Advantage, Forcing The Raiser To Check 65% To 78% Of The Time.
rows.ip_strategy: Check Back The Majority Of Your Range (65% To 78%), Especially When You Open From UTG, MP, Or Cutoff Where You Lack Low Two-Pair And Straight Combinations. | Even With Overpairs (AA, KK, QQ), Mix In Frequent Protective Check-Backs And Medium 50% Bets: An Overpair Is Merely A Bluff-Catcher Against A Check-Raise On 8-7-6. | Never C-Bet Unimproved Offsuit Broadways (AKo, AQo, KQo) Without A Flush Draw On 8-7-6: They Have Nearly Zero Fold Equity And Terrible Playability Against Check-Raises.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: In Big Blind Vs Early Position, You Can Introduce A Direct Flop Donk-Bet (Leading Out 33% To 50% Pot) Or Check-Raise At An Aggressive 18% To 24% Frequency. | Put Maximum Pressure On The Opener's Capped Overpairs By Fast-Playing Straights (T9, 95, 54), Sets (88, 77, 66), Two Pairs (87s, 76s, 86s), And Pair-Plus-Draw Hands (98s, 75s, 65s). | If The Preflop Raiser Checks Back The Flop, Attack The Turn With Polarized 75% To 100% Bets Across Non-Pairing Runouts.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: Any 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, Or Ten On The Turn Puts A Four-Liner Straight On The Board. Proceed With Extreme Caution With Naked Overpairs And Prioritize Flush Draws Plus Straight Blockers (Such As 99 Or TT).

rows.nut_advantage: In-Position Raiser (Holds More Nut As And Qs Flush Draws)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Offsuit High Card (Non-Spade Ace, King, Queen, Or Brick)
rows.summary: Monotone Single-Suit Flops (Three Cards Of The Same Suit, Such As Ks 9s 4s Or Ah Jh 5h) Radically Compress Bet Sizings Across The Entire Game Tree. Because Any Single Card Of That Suit On The Turn Or River Completes A Four-Flush, Solvers Exclusively Use Small 25% To 33% Pot Bets To Protect Equity And Force Folds From Zero-Flush-Card Hands.
rows.ip_strategy: Never Use Large 75% Or 100% C-Bets On Monotone Flops: A Small 25% To 33% Pot Bet Accomplishes Full Fold Equity Against Opponents With Zero Cards Of The Flush Suit While Risking Minimal Chips When Behind A Flopped Flush. | C-Bet Flopped Flushes, Sets, Strong Top Pairs, And Single-Card High Flush Draws (As-X, Qs-X, Js-X) At 33% Pot. | Check Back Some Vulnerable Medium Hands Holding A Mid-Ranked Flush Card (Such As 9d Ts Or Pocket Tens With The Ts) To Realize A Free Turn Card.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Fold Any Unpaired Hand That Contains Zero Cards Of The Monotone Suit Immediately Against Even A 25% Pot Bet. | Check-Call Most Of Your Flopped Medium Flushes (Such As 8s 7s Or Ts 6s) And Single-Spade Top Pairs Rather Than Check-Raising Into The Opener's Nut Flush And As-X Blocker Region. | On A Fourth Flush Card On The Turn Or River, Use The Bare Ace Of That Suit (Nut Flush Blocker) As Your Primary Polarized Bluff.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: When The Turn Is An Offsuit Brick, The Preflop Raiser Can Size Up To 66% To 75% Pot With Made Flushes, Sets, And As-X Nut Flush Draws. When A Fourth Card Of The Monotone Suit Lands, Shift To Small Block Bets And Nut-Flush-Blocker Overbets.

rows.range_advantage: Extreme In-Position Preflop Raiser (+60% To 40% Equity)
rows.nut_advantage: In-Position Raiser (Holds AK, KQ, KJ, KTs, AA, 44)
rows.summary: High-Paired Dry Flops (Such As Ks Kh 4d, As Ad 6c, Or Qh Qd 5s) Heavily Favor The Preflop Raiser Because Two Of The Top Card Are Already On The Felt And The Opener Holds Far More Combinations Of The Paired Broadway Card (AK, KQ, KJ, KTs) Than The Big Blind Defender. Solvers Bet 90% To 98% Of Hands For 25% To 33% Pot.
rows.ip_strategy: Execute A 95%+ Small 25% To 33% Pot Range C-Bet Across Your Entire Range, Including Complete Air And Underpairs. | Always Slow-Play Full Houses (44, K4s) And Strong Trips (AK, KQ) By Betting The Exact Same 25% To 33% Size As Your Bluffs: Raising Or Sizing Up On K-K-4 Folds Out The Defender's Entire Unpaired Range. | If The Big Blind Calls The Flop C-Bet, Check Back Medium Pocket Pairs (66-QQ) On The Turn For Pot Control And Delay-Value On The River.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Because A 25% Pot C-Bet Offers 5-To-1 Direct Pot Odds, You Must Float Wide With All Pocket Pairs (22-QQ), Any 4x, Ace-High (AQ-A2), And Backdoor Broadway Cards (QJs, JTs) Having Backdoor Flush Equity. | Check-Call Almost All Of Your Trips (Kx) On The Flop To Keep The Opener's Wide Range C-Bet Bluffs Active Heading To The Turn. | Probe-Bet 50% To 66% Pot On The River Whenever The Preflop Raiser Bets The Flop And Checks Back The Turn.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: Because Both Players Rarely Hold A King (Only Two Kings Remain In The Deck), Turn Play Revolves Around Pocket Pairs And Ace-High Showdown Value. Use Polarized 75% Turn Bets Exclusively With Trips+, Overpairs, And High-Equity Turn Draws.

rows.range_advantage: Slight In-Position Edge (53% To 47% Overpair Equity)
rows.nut_advantage: Big Blind Defender (Holds Far More 4x Trips: A4o, K4s, 64s, 54s, 43s)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Ace, King, Queen (Overcards That Counterfeited Or Outkick Low Pairs)
rows.summary: Low-Paired Flops (Such As 7s 4h 4d, 8c 5h 5d, Or 6s 3c 3d) Create A Dramatic Clash Between Range Advantage And Nut Advantage. While The In-Position Raiser Holds More Overpairs (88-AA), The Big Blind Defender Holds 2.5x More Combinations Of Trips (A4, K4s, Q4s, 64s, 54s, 43s), Making Low-Paired Flops The Highest Check-Raise Frequency Texture In Hold'em (19% To 26%).
rows.ip_strategy: Use A Small 33% Pot C-Bet At Moderate-To-High Frequency (65% To 75%), But Prepare Yourself Mentally And Technically For Frequent Big Blind Check-Raises. | Against The Big Blind's High-Frequency Check-Raise, Defend By Calling With All Overpairs (88-AA), Any 7x, Pocket Pairs 22-66, And Strong Ace-High Hands With Backdoor Flush/Straight Equity (AK, AQ, A5s, A3s). | Check Back Vulnerable Unimproved Offsuit Broadways (KJo, QTo) That Cannot Call A Check-Raise.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Punish 33% Range C-Bettors By Check-Raising 20% To 25% Of Your Range On 7-4-4 And 8-5-5. | Construct Your Check-Raise Range Around 4x Trips, 77 Full House, Strong 7x Protection Raises, And A Wide Array Of Backdoor Straight/Flush Bluffs (65s, 86s, 53s, A5s, A3s, K8s). | Barrel High-Card Turns Selectively After Check-Raising To Pressure The Opener's Floating Ace-High And Medium Pairs.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: When An Overcard (A, K, Q) Lands On The Turn After The Big Blind Calls A Flop C-Bet, The Preflop Raiser Regains Equity And Can Barrel 66% To 75% Pot To Pressure 7x And Pocket Pairs 55-66.

rows.range_advantage: Strong In-Position Preflop Raiser (+57% To 43% Equity)
rows.nut_advantage: In-Position Raiser (AA, KK, QQ, KQ, AK)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Non-Spade Ace, Jack, Ten, Or Brick Low Card
rows.summary: Double-Broadway Two-Tone Flops (Such As Ks Qs 5d, Ah Jh 4c, Or Ks Js 6d) Give The Preflop Raiser A Commanding Top-Pair, Two-Pair, And Set Advantage While Providing Flush And Broadway Gutshot Equity For Semi-Bluffs. Solvers Favor Medium-To-Large 50% To 75% C-Bets Across 75%+ Of The Opener's Range.
rows.ip_strategy: Size Up From 33% To 50% Or 75% Pot To Charge Flush Draws, Straight Gutshots (JTs, ATs, T9s), And Middle Pairs (Qx). | Value-Bet AA, KK, QQ, KQ, AK, KJ, And KTs Strongly While Semi-Bluffing With Ace-High Flush Draws, Gutshots (AT, AJ, JT), And Backdoor Spades. | Check Back Underpairs Below The Second Broadway Card (66-JJ On K-Q-5) To Avoid Bloating The Pot Against Six-Way Broadway Overcards.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Fold Dominated Underpairs (22-44, 66-99 Without A Spade) Against A 66% To 75% C-Bet On K-Q-5. | Defend Primarily With Kx, Strong Qx (QJs, QTs), Flush Draws, And Open-Ended / Gutshot Broadway Draws (JTs, ATs). | Reserve Check-Raises For 55 (Bottom Set), KQs/K5s (Two Pair), And Combo Flush + Straight Draws (Js Ts, As Ts, As Js).
rows.turn_barrel_rules: On Non-Flush Offsuit Brick Turns, The Preflop Raiser Can Fire A 75% To 125% Turn Barrel With AK, KQ, Sets, And Nut Flush/Straight Draws To Force Out Second-Pair Qx And Weak Kx.

rows.nut_advantage: Big Blind Defender (Holds 32s Wheel Straight, 54s, A5o, A4o, 55, 44)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Offsuit King, Queen, Or Ace (Pairing Top Card)
rows.summary: Unlike Dry Ace-High Flops (A-7-2r), Wheel-Ace Low Connected Flops (Such As As 5s 4d, Ah 4h 3c, Or As 5d 2c) Strip The Preflop Raiser Of Their Nut Advantage. Because The Big Blind Defends All 32s, 63s, 76s, 54s, A5o, And A4o Combinations, Top Pair Top Kicker (AK) Can Already Be Drawing Thin Against Flopped Wheels And Two Pairs.
rows.ip_strategy: Do Not Auto-Bet 90% Of Your Range Just Because An Ace Is On The Flop: Trim Your C-Bet Frequency Down To ~45% Using A Controlled 33% To 50% Pot Sizing. | Check Back Some Strong Ax Hands (AJo, ATo) And Underpairs (88-KK) To Control Pot Size And Protect Your Checking Range. | When Facing A Big Blind Check-Raise On A-5-4, Respect That Their Range Is Loaded With Wheel Straights (32, 76), Sets (55, 44), And Two Pairs (A5, A4, 54).
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Check-Raise Aggressively (15% To 19%) With Flopped Straights (32s, 76s), Sets (55, 44), Two Pairs (A5, A4, 54s), And High-Equity Wheel/Flush Combo Draws (6s 3s, 7s 6s, Ks 3s, Qs 3s). | Lead Out On The Turn Whenever The Preflop Raiser Checks Back The Flop, Applying Pressure To Their Capped Pocket Pairs 88-KK. | Avoid Slow-Playing Two Pair (54s) On Two-Tone Wheel Boards Where Any Ace, Higher Card, Or Flush Card Can Counterfeit Or Outdraw You.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: An Ace Or High Broadway Card On The Turn Favors The Preflop Raiser (Counterfeiting 54 Two Pair Or Making AK Top Two Pair), Whereas Any 2, 3, 6, 7, Or Flush Card Massively Favors The Big Blind.

rows.nut_advantage: In-Position Raiser (Holds All Overpairs TT-AA; Shared Sets 99/55/22)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Ace, King, Queen, Jack (Overcards Improving Raiser Unpaired Hands)
rows.summary: Disconnected Rainbow Rag Flops (Such As 9s 5h 2d, Tc 6d 2h, Or 8s 4h 2c) Offer Zero Front-Door Flush Draws And Virtually Zero Open-Ended Straight Draws. The Preflop Raiser Holds An Exclusive Monopoly On Overpairs (TT Through AA) Plus High-Card Overcard Equity, Driving High-Frequency 33% To 50% Continuation Bets.
rows.ip_strategy: C-Bet 75% To 85% Of Your Range Using A 33% To 50% Pot Sizing: Because All Three Board Cards Are 9 Or Lower, Your Two Broadway Overcards (AK, AQ, KQ, QJ) Hold 25%+ Six-Out Equity And Deny The Big Blind's Equity. | Size Up To 66% To 75% Pot With Overpairs (TT-AA) And Strong 9x Against Loose-Passive Callers Who Float Any Pair Or Gutshot. | Fire Aggressive Second Barrels Whenever A Broadway Overcard (J, Q, K, A) Lands On The Turn.
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Because No Obvious Front-Door Draws Exist On 9-5-2 Rainbow, Build A 13% To 16% Check-Raise Range Merging Sets (55, 22), Two Pair (95s), And Backdoor Gutshot/Flush Bluffs (87s, 76s, 64s, 43s, A4s, A3s). | Float 33% C-Bets With Any Pair (2x, 5x, 9x, 33-88) Plus Ace-High Hands Holding A Backdoor Straight Or Flush Card. | Check-Raise Or Lead Out On Low Turn Cards (3, 4, 6) That Complete Backdoor Wheel And Mid-Range Straights.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: Any Broadway Overcard (T, J, Q, K, A) On The Turn Massively Shifts Equity Further Toward The Preflop Raiser, Making It An Automatic High-Frequency Double-Barrel Spot.

rows.range_advantage: In-Position Preflop Raiser (+56% To 44% Overpair & High-Card Edge)
rows.nut_advantage: In-Position Raiser (Holds AA-99 Full Houses Plus Case Quads)
rows.best_turn_barrels: Ace, King, Queen (Pairing High Cards For Higher Full Houses)
rows.summary: Trips-On-Board Flops (Three Of A Kind Dealt Directly On The Flop, Occurring Only 0.24% Of The Time, Such As 8s 8h 8d) Transform Texas Hold'em Into A Battle Of Pocket Pairs (Full Houses) And High-Card Kickers. Because The Preflop Raiser Holds Far More Overpairs (99-AA) And Ace-King High Cards, Solvers Range-Bet 25% To 33% Pot.
rows.ip_strategy: Bet 25% To 33% Pot With Nearly Your Entire Range: Because Only One Eight Remains In The Deck, Any Pocket Pair Is Already A Full House (Eights Full), And Ace-High Is Playing Board Trips With An Ace Kicker. | Never Bet Large On The Flop With Quads (A8s, 98s) Or Overfulls (AA, KK): Keep The Defender's Worse Pocket Pairs (22-77) And Ace-High Hands In The Pot. | Be Careful With Under-Fulls (22-77 On 8-8-8) On High-Card Turns And Rivers: If The Turn And River Are K-Q And Your Opponent Has Kx Or Qx, Your 66 Full House Is Counterfeited Into Eights Full Of Sixes Vs Eights Full Of Kings!
rows.oop_defense_strategy: Call The Small Flop C-Bet With Every Pocket Pair (22+), Any Ace-High Hand, And Two-Broadway Hands (KQs, KJs) That Have Six Outs To Pair And Make A Higher Full House. | Remember That Under-Fulls (22-77 On 8-8-8) Lose To Any Overpair (99-AA) And Also Lose Whenever An Opponent Pairs A Higher Turn Or River Card (9 Through Ace). | Check-Call The Case Eight (Quads) On The Flop And Turn To Allow The Raiser To Barrel Off With Overpairs Or Ace-High.
rows.turn_barrel_rules: When A High Card (Such As A King Or Ace) Lands On The Turn On 8-8-8, Any Player Holding An Ace Or King Now Makes Eights Full Of Aces/Kings, Instantly Crushing All Pocket Pairs Below That Card (22-QQ).
